title: Slow graph bootstrap percolation III: Chain constructions
reading_level: Section7.1, Definition7.1 and Theorems7.2/7.3 read; proof in AppendixA not audited
finding: The authors explicitly report being unable to recover the cited unpublished general K-fold Sidon proof. Their replacement Theorem7.3 restricts four-variable coefficient magnitudes to an m-dependent progression and parity; it does not establish unrestricted simultaneous avoidance for every bounded coefficient pattern.
implication: Do not treat this restricted theorem as the unrestricted estimate required by2610.19960v1 Remark5.3. Keep the localization route unless a matching proof is supplied.
limits: This is a dependency mismatch and unresolved proof provenance, not a disproof of the general Sidon estimate or the Microsoft construction. No theorem from the complete bootstrap-percolation paper is audited.
falsifier: A checked construction satisfying the exact unrestricted coefficient family and size needed for the intended checksum application would discharge this hold.
reason: Supporting bibliography for existing Microsoft source; no new discovery or paper.
